records.name: Fine Sand
records.description: Low nutrients, poor malleability (doesn't hold shape), decent weather resistance, some aesthetic potential in decorative applications.

records.name: Volcanic Ash
records.description: Moderate nutrients (after aging), low weight, low weather resistance in raw form.

records.name: Desert Sand
records.description: Desert Sand material.

records.name: Peat
records.description: Excellent nutrients (for specific plants), very low hardness/weight, but breaks down easily (low weather resistance).

records.name: Chalk Dust
records.description: Low hardness, low nutrients, crumbles easily.
records.usesRaw: Reduce Soil acidity, Stabilize ground in construction, pigments

records.name: Contaminated Soil
records.description: High toxicity, very low nutrients, generic physical properties.

records.name: Loam
records.description: High nutrients, good workability (malleability) for farming, average weather resistance.

records.name: Silt
records.description: Between sand and clay, good for some agriculture but prone to erosion.

records.name: Heartvein
records.description: Mercury, bright red.

records.name: Solder
records.description: tin and lead, some copper or silver

records.name: Clay
records.description: Very high malleability (pottery, bricks), moderate nutrients, good weather resistance when processed.

records.name: Pumice
records.description: Extremely lightweight, very low hardness, poor general utility beyond insulation/abrasive.

records.name: Gloomshard
records.description: Lead, shiny, silvery gray
records.usesRaw: Batteries, radiation shield, silver, black pigment

records.name: Gravel
records.description: High blunt potential (good for basic paths, rough impact), no malleability, poor nutrients.

records.name: Cloudstone
records.description: Aluminum - Reddish brown clay or rock

records.name: Grim-Coal
records.description: Manganese, soft, black, powdery
records.usesRaw: Steel and aluminum, batteries, dark pigments

records.name: Pewter
records.description: Tin, small amount of copper or bismuth

records.name: Echostone
records.description: Often layered, crumbly, some nutrient potential if weathered, generally low utility.

records.name: Amberspark
records.description: Copper Ore, brassy yellow,

records.name: Witch-Glass
records.description: Zinc - yellow brown to black, resinous.
uses: Coating steel to prevent rust and decay. White pigments
records.usesRaw: Coating steel to prevent rust and decay. White pigments, some fertilizers

records.name: Sandstone
records.description: Softer than granite, easy to carve, lower weather resistance.

records.name: Ironroot
records.description: Iron - Reddish brown
records.usesRaw: Carvings and jewels when polished, reddish brown pigments

records.name: Sterling Silver
records.description: Silver and Copper

records.name: Glowstone
records.description: Nickel, bronze-yellow

records.name: Limestone
records.description: Softer, can have some minor nutrients (calcium), moderate beauty, susceptible to acid rain.

records.name: Bog-Iron
records.description: Tin - Dark Brown or Black

records.name: Slate
records.description: Splits easily (good for roofing/tiles), good weather resistance, moderate hardness.

records.name: Brass
records.description: Copper and Zinc

records.name: Marble
records.description: Moderate hardness, high beauty (sculpture, decorative), can be somewhat malleable for shaping but still brittle.

records.name: Star-Splinter
records.description: Titanium, reddish brown to black

records.name: Duralumin
records.description: copper, manganese. High Strength
uses: aircrafts(high strength low weight). Climbing equipment
records.usesRaw: aircrafts(high strength low weight). Climbing equipment, bicycles, etc.

records.name: Obsidian
records.description: Extremely high sharpness potential (natural glass), lower hardness for blunting, very lightweight, high beauty (often used for primitive tools/jewelry)
records.usesRaw: Tools and Weapons, Super sharp tools, Jewelry

records.name: Bronze
records.description: Copper and Tin
uses: machine parts with good wear resistance
records.usesRaw: Decorative, machine parts with good wear resistance, boat/water proof stuff

records.name: Deepstone
records.description: Very dense and hard, good blunt potential, dark appearance.

records.name: Cast Iron
records.description: Iron with more Carbon

records.name: Granite
records.description: Very hard, good weather resistance, decent beauty, difficult to shape.

records.name: Nichrome
records.description: Nickel and Chromium

records.name: Steel
records.description: Iron and Carbon/Manganese, nickel - Strength and Versatility

records.name: Quartz
records.description: Very hard, very good weather resistance, high beauty (many gem varieties).

records.name: Stainless Steel
records.description: Iron, nickel, chromium
